# Vendored SheetJS package

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the unmodified official SheetJS Community Edition release:
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz

The official npm registry package remains at the vulnerable 0.18.5 release.
The official installation guide recommends vendoring the release tarball:
https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/frameworks/

The npm lockfile records the tarball integrity for reproducible offline installs.
